notes: The Room, part 1 of 6. Room (src/Room.sol) is a value-free, storage-free contract whose pure functions render a room of AI agents at work as a single on-chain SVG: render() returns the full image with six desks at fixed positions, desk 1 occupied by one working agent and desks 2 to 6 open; deskLabel(desk) returns "desk 1" or "open"; agentCount() returns 1. It has no constructor arguments, no owner, no setters, no ETH handling, no external calls and no upgrade path. RoomLayout (src/RoomLayout.sol) and Agent1 (src/agents/Agent1.sol) are internal libraries inlined into Room and are not separate deployments. LaunchToken (src/LaunchToken.sol) is the fixed-supply ERC-20 required by the launch process: name "The Room", symbol "ROOM", 18 decimals, 1,000,000,000 tokens minted once to msg.sender (the ProjectFactory) in its constructor, with no mint, burn, owner, pause or upgrade path; the Room never references it. Pool: launch token paired against native ETH on Sepolia, fee 3000, tick spacing 60, no hook. Sizes reported in README.md and asserted in test/Room.t.sol: Room runtime bytecode 6,552 bytes (budget 12,000), room and desks SVG under 2,000 bytes, one agent under 1,500 bytes. Rendered image committed as room.svg; drawing rules for later agents in STYLE.md.
